items_flat.title_en: OpenAI News lists Aug 31 Product post: “A milestone in expanding access to AI”
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 新聞頁列出 8/31 產品文：〈擴大 AI 取用的里程碑〉
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s official News index still dates a Product item titled “A milestone in expanding access to AI” to August 31, 2026, above the Aug 28 company posts on Cursor/SpaceX and Thailand startups. A guessed /index slug returns 404; the listing is live on openai.com/news but the article body was not retrievable in this window.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方新聞頁仍把產品類文章〈A milestone in expanding access to AI〉標為 2026 年 8 月 31 日，排在 8/28 Cursor／SpaceX 與泰國新創兩則公司文之上。推測的 /index 網址回傳 404；openai.com/news 清單存在，但本時段仍讀不到正文。
items_flat.analysis_en: The date stamp is official and new for this Taipei calendar day, but without a readable body the scope—product, pricing, geography, or partnership—remains unverified. Treat the headline as a listing fact, not as a confirmed program launch.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 日期戳是官方且屬於本台北曆日，但正文未公開可讀，範圍（產品、價格、地區或合作）尚未核實。目前只能當成「有這則標題上架」，不能當成計畫已完整公布。

items_flat.title_en: GPT-5.4 leaves Codex for ChatGPT-signed-in users as of August 31
items_flat.title_zh: 自 8 月 31 日起，以 ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 停用 GPT-5.4
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s Help Center and Codex model docs state that GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini are no longer available in Codex for users signed in with a ChatGPT account as of August 31, 2026. Recommended replacements are GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-5.6 Luna. The same notices say the OpenAI API and Codex sessions authenticated with an API key are not affected.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 說明中心與 Codex 模型文件寫明：自 2026 年 8 月 31 日起，以 ChatGPT 帳號登入的 Codex 不再提供 GPT-5.4 與 GPT-5.4 mini，建議改用 GPT-5.6 Terra 與 GPT-5.6 Luna。同一公告指出 OpenAI API，以及用自有 API Key 驗證的 Codex 工作階段不受影響。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a channel sunset, not a company-wide model death: ChatGPT-login Codex is forced onto the 5.6 family, while API customers can keep 5.4. Teams that hardcoded 5.4 inside ChatGPT-signed Codex configs, custom agents, or scheduled tasks will break today unless they have already remapped IDs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路下架，不是全公司消滅模型：ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 被導向 5.6 家族，API 客戶仍可用 5.4。若工作區預設、自訂 agent 或排程任務仍寫死 5.4，今天就會失敗。
items_flat.quote: On August 31, 2026, GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini will no longer be available in Codex when you sign in with your ChatGPT account.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自 2026 年 8 月 31 日起，以 ChatGPT 帳號登入 Codex 時，將不再提供 GPT-5.4 與 GPT-5.4 mini。

links.label: OpenAI Help Center — Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan

items_flat.title_en: Mistral retires Medium 3 and Medium 3.1; docs point to Medium 3.5
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 退役 Medium 3 與 3.1，文件改指向 Medium 3.5
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral’s official models documentation lists retirement on August 31, 2026 for Mistral Medium 3 (`mistral-medium-2505`) and Mistral Medium 3.1 (`mistral-medium-2508`). The documented replacement for both is Mistral Medium 3.5. Featured-model listings now lead with Medium 3.5 rather than the 2505/2508 IDs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 官方模型文件將 Mistral Medium 3（`mistral-medium-2505`）與 Medium 3.1（`mistral-medium-2508`）的退役日列為 2026 年 8 月 31 日，兩者替代品皆為 Mistral Medium 3.5。精選模型清單已改以 Medium 3.5 為主，不再主推 2505／2508。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cutoff consolidates Mistral’s mid-tier API onto a single current SKU. Integrations still calling the 2505/2508 IDs should fail or be rejected after today unless a hidden compatibility alias remains—which the public docs do not promise.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此截止把中階 API 收斂到單一現役 SKU。若整合仍呼叫 2505／2508，今日之後應失敗或被拒；公開文件未承諾相容別名。
items_flat.quote: Mistral Medium 3.1 … 5/22/2026 8/31/2026 … Mistral Medium 3.5; Mistral Medium 3 … 5/22/2026 8/31/2026 … Mistral Medium 3.5
items_flat.quote_zh: Mistral Medium 3.1……淘汰日 2026-08-31……改用 Mistral Medium 3.5；Mistral Medium 3……淘汰日 2026-08-31……改用 Mistral Medium 3.5

items_flat.title_en: Google shuts Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 preview endpoint on August 31
items_flat.title_zh: Google 於 8 月 31 日關閉 Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 預覽端點
items_flat.summary_en: Google’s official Gemini API deprecations table lists `gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview` with a shutdown date of August 31, 2026 and names `gemini-robotics-er-2-preview` as the replacement. Robotics overview docs had already instructed callers to swap the model ID before the end of August.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 官方 Gemini API 退役表將 `gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview` 的關閉日列為 2026 年 8 月 31 日，替代端點為 `gemini-robotics-er-2-preview`。機器人總覽文件此前已要求在 8 月底前更換模型 ID。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a preview-endpoint teardown, not a new robotics model launch. Embodied-reasoning stacks still pointing at ER 1.6 will lose the API surface today; behavior parity with ER 2 (video progress, multi-robot orchestration, streaming) still has to be revalidated per deployment.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是預覽端點拆除，不是新機器人模型發表。仍指向 ER 1.6 的具身推理堆疊今天會失去該 API；與 ER 2（影片進度、多機器人編排、串流）是否行為等價，仍須各自驗證。

brief_en: A quiet cutoff day: OpenAI lists an Aug 31 Product post on expanding AI access whose body is still unreadable, GPT-5.4 leaves ChatGPT-login Codex, Mistral retires Medium 3/3.1 for 3.5, and Google shuts Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 preview. No new flagship models.
brief_zh: 今日偏「下架日」：OpenAI 新聞頁掛出 8/31「擴大 AI 取用」產品文但正文仍讀不到；ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 停用 GPT-5.4；Mistral Medium 3/3.1 退役改走 3.5；Google 關閉 Robotics ER 1.6 預覽端點。無新旗艦模型。
